title: The handoff rule hands the rest to a fresh leader through waggledance instead of asking the user to open a new session
action: D1 of docs/history/handoff-self-relaunch/CONTEXT.md: every doctrine home of rule agents-context-handoff-65 says that at about 150k tokens or 65% context the leader writes the handoff, then hands the remaining work to a fresh leader through the host's leader door when one exists (waggledance: the MCP tool waggledance_dispatch with leader: true, the task text naming what is done, what is next and the user's standing orders), and releases its session. It never tells the user to open a new session, never waits for a /clear, and never spawns the leader itself (no paseo create_agent). The handoff is shown to the user and the session waits only when a gate or decision the user owns is pending, or when the host has no leader door. Keep 'holds mid-wave too', 'every feature close is also a handoff point', the schema pointer, the safe-boundary rule and the resume triage as they are. Edit packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md (Care for the session) and render AGENTS.md ONLY through `.bee/bin/bee dev regen`, never by hand. Update the other listed homes to match: go-mode.md Fallback Paths line ('Resume in a new session' goes), the swarming SKILL.md handoff paragraph, swarming-reference.md 'Fresh-session handoff in full' (the planned-next record is written, then the leader door opens the fresh session, which adopts the claim), docs/handbook/stages/swarming.md, the spoken line of agents-context-handoff-65 in the doctrine-layer rule index, and the hook-runtime token-economy page where it quotes the old hook line (the new hook line is being written by sibling cell hsrl-2: 'context {n}k tokens is past the handoff mark ({t}k): finish this step, write the handoff (bee state handoff write --kind planned-next), hand the rest to waggledance (waggledance_dispatch, leader: true), and release this session — never ask the user to open a new one.'). Use rg to find any other copy of the old wording outside docs/history and .bee and fix it only if it is in your file list; report any other. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: hsrl-1`.
